description: Replace an Instagram channel's greeting prompts (max 4) and persistent chat menu (max 20 items). Pass the full lists; an empty list removes that part. A tap sends a postback with the item's payload: it fires flows with the "Instagram button tapped" trigger, and the channel's bot answers taps no flow handles (as if the person typed the title). Menu items are either a postback (payload) or a link (url).

id.description: UUID of the Instagram social channel

menu.description: Persistent menu items, in display order

url.description: Open this link instead of sending a postback

payload.description: Sent back on tap. Defaults to the question.

question.description: Shown to the person, e.g. 'What are your prices?'

name: neuron_set_instagram_chat_menu
title: Set Instagram Greeting Prompts & Menu
